# coding_tools

coding_tools is a local AI git commit message generator that writes conventional commits from diffs for developers.

## Canonical pages

- Repository: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/coding_tools
- README: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/coding_tools/blob/master/README.md
- Entry point: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/coding_tools/blob/master/main.py
- Configuration: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/coding_tools/tree/master/data
- Git diff handling: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/coding_tools/tree/master/src
- llama.cpp: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp

## Quickstart

```bash
conda create --name ct python=3.12.8 -y
conda activate ct
python3 main.py --help
```

Build or install a local llama.cpp server with the Gemma GGUF model, then run
`python main.py /path/to/repository`.

## Scope

The tool monitors one or more Git repositories, sends diffs to a local
llama.cpp-compatible server, and generates conventional commit suggestions.
It is an offline developer utility, not a hosted commit API.
